entities.name: Eligeth
entities.description: Sphinx from an unknown plane who stumbled on a forbidden truth and now exists about five minutes into every possible future.

entities.name: Multiverse
entities.description: Source of the secrets sphinxes seek.

events.summary: Centuries ago, Eligeth stumbles upon a truth no being was supposed to know and comes to exist five minutes into every possible future.
events.quote: Centuries ago, Eligeth stumbled upon a truth that no being was supposed to know
